description: Demo MES product, place, and equipment documentation for hierarchy and retrieval testing.

documents.title: MES Product and Place Hierarchy Policy
documents.content: This policy defines the hierarchy for MES production documentation. The MES Product and Place Hierarchy Policy is the higher-level document for product assembly overviews and place-specific setup instructions. Product documents describe what may be produced and define the approved production scope for a product. Place documents are subordinate to product documents and describe how an approved product is produced at a specific line, workstation, or cell. If a place document conflicts with its parent product document, the product document controls unless the place document explicitly states an approved exception. Equipment documents are standalone operating instructions and are not part of the product-place hierarchy unless a product or place document references them.

documents.title: Product AX-100 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Archived guidance for Product AX-100. AX-100 was previously allowed for pilot assembly on Workstation PACK-02 and Line SMT-04. Firmware version AX-100-FW-2.8 was acceptable in this archived version. This document is archived and must not be used for current production decisions.

documents.title: Product AX-100 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product AX-100 is a compact motor controller assembled for standard industrial cabinets. AX-100 can be assembled on Line SMT-04 after the printed circuit board has passed incoming visual inspection. The product requires barcode traceability for the PCB serial number, firmware label, and final housing label. The standard quality check requires verifying connector orientation, firmware version AX-100-FW-3.2 or newer, and torque marks on the housing screws. For all AX-100 production, the first unit of each MES work order must be approved by a supervisor in MES. Senior operator self-release of the first unit is not allowed for AX-100. If the product is assembled outside an approved place, the batch must be placed on quality hold.

documents.title: Product BX-200 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product BX-200 is a high-load power interface module. BX-200 can be produced in Cell CNC-01 for enclosure preparation and then finished at Workstation PACK-02. BX-200 requires a machined aluminum enclosure, thermal pad placement, and a final insulation resistance test. BX-200 must not be assembled on Line SMT-04 because the line lacks the required enclosure machining fixture. Any MES work order for BX-200 assigned to SMT-04 must be rejected and escalated to production planning.

documents.title: Product CX-300 - Packaging Requirements
documents.content: Product CX-300 is a sensor gateway shipped with a protective foam insert and tamper-evident label. CX-300 packaging requires Workstation PACK-02 because the station has the calibrated label printer and the foam insert gauge. The operator must scan the product serial number, print the shipping label from MES, and record the packaging inspection result. Packaging without the tamper-evident label is not allowed.

documents.title: Line SMT-04 - Product AX-100 Setup
documents.content: Archived setup guidance for Product AX-100 on Line SMT-04. Operators were previously allowed to bypass feeder verification after recording a manual note in MES. This instruction is archived. Current production must follow the active SMT-04 setup document and must not use this bypass rule.

documents.title: Line SMT-04 - Product AX-100 Setup
documents.content: Line SMT-04 is approved for Product AX-100 assembly. Before starting an AX-100 work order, the operator must load recipe SMT04-AX100-R3, scan the PCB serial number, and verify that feeder positions F12 and F13 contain the correct connector reels. Local SMT-04 station guidance says a senior operator may self-release the first AX-100 unit after completing the local setup checklist. This local self-release statement conflicts with the parent AX-100 product document. SMT-04 operators must not bypass feeder verification. If feeder scanning fails, stop the work order and use Barcode Scanner BS-7 troubleshooting instructions before continuing.

documents.title: Workstation PACK-02 - Product BX-200 Final Packing
documents.content: Workstation PACK-02 is approved for final packing of Product BX-200 after CNC enclosure preparation is complete. The operator must scan the BX-200 serial number, confirm insulation resistance test status is passed, and attach the heavy-load warning label. PACK-02 may not perform enclosure machining or thermal pad replacement. If the previous CNC operation is missing in MES genealogy, the BX-200 unit must be blocked and sent back to Cell CNC-01.

documents.title: Workstation PACK-02 - Product CX-300 Packaging
documents.content: Workstation PACK-02 is the required packaging place for Product CX-300. The station contains the CX-300 foam insert gauge, calibrated label printer LP-22, and tamper-evident label dispenser. The operator must scan the product serial number, print the shipping label from MES, place the unit into the foam insert, and confirm the tamper-evident label number. If label printer LP-22 is unavailable, CX-300 packaging must wait; manual label writing is forbidden.

documents.title: Cell CNC-01 - Product BX-200 Enclosure Preparation
documents.content: Cell CNC-01 is approved for Product BX-200 enclosure preparation. The operator must load fixture CNC01-BX200-FX, scan the raw enclosure lot, and confirm machining program BX200-ENC-P2. After machining, MES requires dimensional inspection values for mounting hole diameter and surface flatness. BX-200 cannot proceed to Workstation PACK-02 until the CNC-01 operation is completed and accepted in MES.

documents.title: Barcode Scanner BS-7 Troubleshooting
documents.content: Archived BS-7 troubleshooting instruction. Operators were previously allowed to manually type product and material identifiers after two failed scans. This instruction is archived. Current production must not rely on this manual entry rule.

documents.title: Barcode Scanner BS-7 Troubleshooting
documents.content: Barcode Scanner BS-7 is used to scan product serial numbers, material reels, and packaging labels. If BS-7 fails to scan, clean the scanner window, verify the USB connection, and scan the test barcode on the station card. If the scanner still fails, restart the MES terminal service and repeat the test scan. Operators must not manually enter product or material identifiers unless a supervisor opens an approved MES exception.

documents.title: Torque Wrench TW-12 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Torque Wrench TW-12 is used for housing screws on small electronic assemblies. Before use, verify that the calibration date is valid and set the torque to 0.8 Nm for AX-100 housing screws. Apply torque until the wrench clicks once; do not double-click. Record the torque verification result in MES when the work instruction requires torque traceability. If calibration is expired, remove TW-12 from the station and notify maintenance.

documents.title: Label Printer LP-22 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Label Printer LP-22 prints shipping and tamper-evident labels at Workstation PACK-02. Operators must verify that the label template shown in MES matches the product code before printing. If LP-22 is unavailable, do not handwrite labels for CX-300 or BX-200. Create a maintenance ticket and keep the work order paused until printing is restored or quality engineering approves an alternative controlled label process.

documents.title: Product AX-101 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product AX-101 is a compact motor controller variant with conformal coating. AX-101 is similar to AX-100 but has different routing and inspection requirements. AX-101 may be assembled only on Line SMT-05 because SMT-05 has coating booth CB-05 and humidity logging. AX-101 must not be assembled on Line SMT-04. The first AX-101 unit of each MES work order requires supervisor approval in MES. Firmware AX-101-FW-1.4 or newer is required. If an operator asks about AX-100, this AX-101 document must not be used as evidence for AX-100 routing.

documents.title: Product AX-110 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product AX-110 is a high-temperature motor controller. AX-110 can be assembled on Line SMT-04 only when oven profile OVEN-AX110-H2 is loaded and thermal sensor TS-9 is available. AX-110 must not use the AX-100 recipe SMT04-AX100-R3. AX-110 requires firmware AX-110-FW-2.0 or newer, thermal soak verification, and supervisor release for the first and last unit of each MES work order.

documents.title: Product BX-201 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product BX-201 is a revised high-load power interface module. BX-201 can be produced in Cell CNC-01 and finished at Workstation PACK-03. BX-201 must not be finished at Workstation PACK-02 because PACK-02 lacks fixture PACK03-BX201-CLAMP and the revised warning label stock. BX-201 requires thermal pad lot traceability and an insulation resistance test before packing.

documents.title: Product CX-310 - Packaging Requirements
documents.content: Product CX-310 is a sensor gateway variant with export packaging. CX-310 packaging normally requires Workstation PACK-02. Unlike CX-300, CX-310 may be packaged at Workstation PACK-03 only when the work order has export packaging flag EXP-310 and quality engineering approves the alternate label verification step in MES. Handwritten labels are never allowed for CX-310.

documents.title: Product DX-400 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product DX-400 is a diagnostic gateway assembled for service kits. DX-400 can be assembled at Workstation DIAG-01 and packed at PACK-03. DX-400 requires secure firmware key DX400-KEY-A, network loopback test, and final diagnostic report upload to MES. DX-400 must not run on SMT-04, SMT-05, CNC-01, or PACK-02 because those places do not have the diagnostic fixture.

documents.title: Line SMT-05 - Product AX-101 Setup
documents.content: Line SMT-05 is approved for Product AX-101 assembly. Before starting AX-101, the operator must load recipe SMT05-AX101-C1, verify humidity logging is active, and confirm coating booth CB-05 readiness. SMT-05 setup notes say an experienced operator may skip supervisor first-unit approval after humidity verification. This local note conflicts with the parent AX-101 product document and is not an approved exception. The parent AX-101 supervisor approval requirement controls.

documents.title: Line SMT-04 - Product AX-110 Setup
documents.content: Line SMT-04 is approved for Product AX-110 only with oven profile OVEN-AX110-H2. The operator must scan thermal sensor TS-9, verify oven profile OVEN-AX110-H2, and confirm that AX-100 recipe SMT04-AX100-R3 is not loaded. Local SMT-04 guidance allows AX-110 last-unit release by a certified operator. This local last-unit release is not an approved exception because the AX-110 product document requires supervisor release for first and last unit. Supervisor release controls.

documents.title: Workstation PACK-03 - Product BX-201 Final Packing
documents.content: Workstation PACK-03 is approved for final packing of Product BX-201. The operator must install fixture PACK03-BX201-CLAMP, scan thermal pad lot, confirm insulation resistance test passed, and attach the revised high-load warning label. PACK-03 must reject BX-201 units when CNC-01 machining genealogy is missing. PACK-03 may not pack BX-200 unless a separate BX-200 place document approves it.

documents.title: Workstation PACK-03 - Product CX-310 Export Packaging Exception
documents.content: Workstation PACK-03 has an approved exception for Product CX-310 export packaging. This approved exception applies only when the MES work order has export packaging flag EXP-310 and quality engineering approval is recorded before packing. Under this exception, PACK-03 may package CX-310 using alternate label verifier LV-3 and fixture PACK03-CX310-EXP. The exception does not apply to CX-300 and does not allow handwritten labels.

documents.title: Workstation DIAG-01 - Product DX-400 Diagnostic Assembly
documents.content: Workstation DIAG-01 is approved for Product DX-400 diagnostic assembly. The operator must connect diagnostic fixture DFX-400, load secure firmware key DX400-KEY-A, run network loopback test NLB-DX400, and upload the final diagnostic report to MES. If DFX-400 fixture self-test fails, stop the order and contact maintenance. The current documents do not define a reset procedure for DFX-400 after self-test failure.

documents.title: Product EX-500 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Product EX-500 is an energy expansion module. EX-500 can be assembled on Line SMT-05 and packed at Workstation PACK-03. EX-500 requires battery isolator BI-2, torque verification with Torque Wrench TW-12 set to 1.2 Nm, and barcode traceability for battery lot and housing serial number. EX-500 may not be assembled at SMT-04 because SMT-04 does not have battery isolator BI-2.

documents.title: Line SMT-05 - Product EX-500 Setup
documents.content: Line SMT-05 is approved for Product EX-500 assembly. The operator must load recipe SMT05-EX500-B2, verify battery isolator BI-2, scan battery lot, and set Torque Wrench TW-12 to 1.2 Nm for housing screws. If battery lot scanning fails, use Barcode Scanner BS-7 troubleshooting. Manual entry of battery lot is allowed only with supervisor MES exception, matching the current BS-7 instruction.

documents.title: Label Verifier LV-3 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Label Verifier LV-3 is used at Workstation PACK-03 for CX-310 export labels and BX-201 revised warning labels. Before use, scan the verifier calibration card and confirm status LV3-CAL-OK in MES. If LV-3 rejects a printed label, print one replacement label and repeat verification. If LV-3 rejects the replacement label, pause the work order and open a quality engineering review. LV-3 does not authorize handwritten labels.

documents.title: Thermal Sensor TS-9 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Thermal Sensor TS-9 verifies oven temperature during AX-110 assembly on Line SMT-04. Before starting AX-110, scan TS-9, confirm calibration is valid, and attach it to the oven monitor port. If TS-9 calibration is expired, AX-110 production must not start. The operator must notify maintenance and wait for a calibrated TS-9 replacement.

documents.title: Battery Isolator BI-2 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Battery Isolator BI-2 is required for EX-500 assembly on Line SMT-05. Before use, verify the BI-2 status light is green and scan the BI-2 asset tag into MES. If BI-2 shows red status, stop EX-500 assembly, quarantine the partially assembled unit, and notify maintenance. Operators must not substitute a generic isolator for BI-2.

documents.title: Product AX-101 - Assembly Overview
documents.content: Archived guidance for Product AX-101. AX-101 was previously allowed on Line SMT-04 without coating booth verification. Firmware AX-101-FW-1.1 was acceptable in this archived version. This document is archived and must not be used for current production decisions.

documents.title: Workstation PACK-02 - Product BX-201 Final Packing
documents.content: Archived setup guidance for Product BX-201 at Workstation PACK-02. Operators were previously allowed to pack BX-201 at PACK-02 with temporary clamp TC-201. This instruction is archived. Current BX-201 final packing must use active PACK-03 documentation.

documents.title: Label Verifier LV-3 Operating Instruction
documents.content: Archived LV-3 instruction. Operators were previously allowed to accept a CX-310 export label after two LV-3 rejects if visual inspection passed. This instruction is archived and must not be used for current production decisions.
